description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The client is a software company, and Raydar is recruiting a Founding Software Engineer on its behalf. The role owns software feature development across the stack with a backend emphasis, partnering with customers from initial discussions through release. Responsibilities include building dependable systems, designing data infrastructure, supporting customer pilots, and shaping engineering practices and product direction.
Founding full-stack engineer building data-driven products, owning deployment, evaluation tooling, and customer pilots

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship features across frontend, backend, data infrastructure and cloud deployment
• Take features from the first customer conversation through release and iteration
• Develop dependable automated workflows, testing and evaluation tooling, and data pipelines, with safeguards that keep system actions traceable and safe
• Design data schemas for large, complex datasets
• Act as the main technical contact for a business customer, understanding needs, supporting adoption and demonstrating value in pilot projects
• Set engineering practices that will guide a growing team and contribute to the product roadmap

Requirements:
• 1 to 4 years of experience, or an exceptional recent graduate
• Full-stack ability with a backend lean, able to turn a spec into near-production software independently
• Fluency in Python or TypeScript, plus experience with a relational database such as Postgres
• A solid computer science foundation, including data storage, system design and large-scale service architecture
• Experience deploying applications to a major cloud platform
• An eye for design and a commitment to a polished user interface
• A strong sense of accountability, humility and openness to candid feedback
• A history of starting projects on your own initiative, whether personal, academic or commercial
• Clear communication with customers and a willingness to learn a new industry domain
• Ambition to eventually lead a team and a collaborative, in-person working style

Preferred:
• Background in competitive programming, olympiads or quantitative trading
• Prior experience as a startup founder
